name: Perennation

abilities.text: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a hexproof counter and an indestructible counter on it.

notes: 'permanent card' is every card type but instant and sorcery. return-from-graveyard binds what it returned, so multi-counters puts both keyword counters (CR 122.1) on it; the format cannot put two DIFFERENT counters on as a replacement (move's withCounters carries one), so they are added immediately after it enters.

issues: ...to the battlefield with a hexproof counter and an indestructible counter on it. — expected The permanent ENTERS the battlefield already carrying both counters (a replacement effect applied as it enters). — scripted return-from-graveyard to battlefield, then a separate multi-counters ['hexproof','indestructible'] on 'that' after it has entered (game.ts:1463). The notes acknowledge this: move's withCounters carries only one counter kind. Observable only against effects that look at counters as the permanent enters ('if it entered with a counter', counter-doubling replacements); within one resolution no SBA or priority intervenes, so ordinary play matches. — CR CR 614.1c

Return target permanent card from your graveyard — expected 'Permanent card' = artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land or planeswalker card; targeted on cast from YOUR graveyard only, re-checked on resolution. — scripted what:{notTypes:['Instant','Sorcery']}, target:true, count:1. The negation is exact (every card is either a permanent card or an instant/sorcery; a Kindred Instant/Sorcery is still excluded by its Instant/Sorcery type), and legal.ts:80 builds a graveyard-card spec with who:'you' because anyGraveyard is absent, so it is a real target restricted to your own graveyard. It enters under your control (game.ts:1411 uses controller p). Correct. — CR CR 110.4a

Return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a hexproof counter and an indestructible counter on it. — expected the card ENTERS the battlefield with the two counters (a replacement effect applying as it enters) — scripted return-from-graveyard to battlefield, then multi-counters adds hexproof + indestructible immediately afterwards (game.ts:1463). No SBA or trigger resolves in between, so ordinary play is identical, but 'enters with counters' replacement interactions (e.g. counter-doubling effects that key on entering) would differ. The notes state this limitation honestly. — CR 614.1c / 122.1

target permanent card from your graveyard — expected any card type but instant/sorcery, in YOUR graveyard, targeted on cast and rechecked on resolution — scripted correct — what:{notTypes:['Instant','Sorcery']} (also excludes 'Kindred Instant'/'Kindred Sorcery'), no anyGraveyard so legal.ts:80 adds who:'you', target:true makes it a real target. Keyword counters do grant the abilities (characteristics.ts:472/492). 3/3 scenarios pass. — CR 110.4a / 608.2b
